title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Simple Interest and Compound Interest
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Alex invested his savings in two parts. The simple interest earned on the first part at 15% per annum for 4 years is the same as the simple interest earned on the second part at 12% per annum for 3 years. Then, the percentage of his savings invested in the first part is
questions.explain: Let parts be $x$ and $y$. Simple interest equation: $x \times 15 \times 4 / 100 = y \times 12 \times 3 / 100 \Rightarrow 60x = 36y \Rightarrow x/y = 36/60 = 3/5$. Percentage invested in the first part is $\frac{3}{3+5} \times 100\% = \frac{3}{8} \times 100\% = 37.5\%$.
